sloka: प्रहस्तवाक्यम् त्वहितम् निशम्य ।विभीषणो राजहितानुकाङिक्षी ।ततो महार्थम् वचनम् बभाषे ।धर्मार्थकामेषु निविष्टबुद्धिः ॥६-१४-९॥।।
transliteration: prahastavākyam tvahitam niśamya ।vibhīṣaṇo rājahitānukāṅikṣī ।tato mahārtham vacanam babhāṣe ।dharmārthakāmeṣu niviṣṭabuddhiḥ ॥6-14-9॥।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana, wishing the welfare of the king, intent upon Dharma, artha and kama, thinking rightly and deeply, spoke these words on hearing Prahastha's words that were not good.
